faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Delhi University JRF/Project Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the JRF/Project Fellow position at Delhi University is 10th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the JRF/Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Physics with a minimum of 55% marks or a CGPA of 6.0 (on a 10-point scale) from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the JRF/Project Fellow position?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 25,000/- to Rs 28,000/- per month for NET/Inspire qualified candidates, and Rs. 14,000/- to Rs 16,000/- per month for other candidates.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send a detailed CV along with supporting documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit for this recruitment. Please refer to the official notification for any further details.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of JRF/Project Fellow in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF/Project Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the JRF/Project Fellow position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any desirable qualification for the JRF/Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: Yes, expertise in Quantum material growth is considered a desirable qualification for the JRF/Project Fellow position.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I attach with my application?
faq.answer: You should attach supporting documents such as B.Sc., M.Sc. marksheets, NET certificate, and any other relevant certificates or proof of experience.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section provided in this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.
